mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a monthly reading, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate above 2.0% and unemployment rate above 4.0% signals a tightening monetary policy coinciding with labor market weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and UNRATE > 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a housing market expansion phase, as measured by rising new housing starts, the S&P 500 exhibits positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased consumer confidence and spending from the housing sector.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST shows month-over-month growth > 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 100.0 (index 2017=100), it signals a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO falls below 100.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When quarterly real GDP growth (GDPC1) falls below 1.0% annualized, it signals an economic slowdown that reduces corporate earnings expectations and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 growth is below 1.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a labor market recovery phase, as indicated by sustained non-farm payroll growth, the S&P 500 exhibits positive forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to rising consumer spending and business investment.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS shows three consecutive months of month-over-month growth > 0.3%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate and increase in non-farm payrolls signals a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE declines > 0.2pp and PAYEMS increases > 0.5% month-over-month, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
